What the data taught us

Prompts you can use today win

NetLine data showed us what B2B professionals download. We doubled down on prompt collections and step-by-step setup guides, and followed every major AI launch within weeks. Our 2026 Claude guides became top performers within months.

    About AI Central Media

    A media company that teaches leaders to put AI to work

    Headquartered in London, AI Central Media is an e-learning and media company reaching more than 300,000 readers across the US, UK and Europe. Through its publications and original content, it teaches C-suite leaders, managers and knowledge workers the tools, prompts and workflows that help them put AI to work.

    The team also provides live coverage of leading AI and tech events, including Cannes Lions, London Tech Week and The AI Summit. Since 2023, it has worked with more than 100 AI companies, SaaS platforms and education brands to reach senior decision-makers and turn attention into pipeline.

    ×Alex Fiore, CEO & Founder · Morgane Marlow, COO · Data as of 13 November 2026
